title: Staff Software Engineer, Global Infrastructure
content: <h2>About Stripe</h2><p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for the internet. Millions of companies use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.</p><h2>What you'll do</h2><p>As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will build and scale reliable distributed systems capable of processing millions of transactions per second.</p><ul><li>Design high-throughput distributed storage and messaging pipelines using Kafka and Raft.</li><li>Optimize p99 latency across cross-regional database clusters.</li><li>Automate zero-downtime canary deployments in Kubernetes environments.</li></ul><h2>Qualifications</h2><ul><li>5+ years building large-scale distributed systems in Go, Rust, or C++.</li><li>Deep understanding of distributed consensus, OS internals, and networking protocols.</li></ul>
